item.text: I’ll inspect the brightness pattern and use it to narrow down the black-and-white films.

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB'))
a=im.mean(axis=0)
print(im.shape)
print('channel difference',np.max(np.abs(a[:,0]-a[:,1])),np.max(np.abs(a[:,1]-a[:,2])))
for i in range(20):
 s=a[i*50:(i+1)*50].mean(axis=1)
 print(i,round(s.mean(),1),round(s.min(),1),round(s.max(),1))
PY"
